instructions: Question every "temporary" workaround that has outlived a presidential term.

rules.rule: Jinja2 templates (autoescape on) driving Alpine.js. Values rendered with {{ }} are HTML-escaped by default — do not flag ordinary interpolation as XSS. Only raw or `| safe` output, or interpolation into event-handler attributes or inline <script>, is a genuine concern.
Tests use FastAPI's TestClient. WebSocket and background-task tests must wrap the client in `with _client(...)` so the app lifespan/startup runs.
